subject: Career Opportunity: speculative enquiry, graduate site or project engineer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Western Civil team,

This is a speculative expression of interest, sent because your careers page invites graduate engineers to send a resume to this address. I'm looking for a graduate site or project engineer place.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, documented in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. In 2019 and 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, handling site inspections, quality checks, materials tracking and progress reports. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your land development team self-performs earthworks, pavements and stormwater drainage on industrial and residential subdivisions, which is the work I trained for, and Derrimut is close to home. I haven't yet worked on an Australian construction site, so I would start under supervision.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate site or project engineer role, or be open to a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: This is a speculative expression of interest for a graduate site or project engineer place at Western Civil. Your careers page says you welcome expressions of interest from undergraduate and graduate engineers, so I am writing to you directly.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. My coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

Your land development work on industrial and residential subdivisions, with earthworks, pavements and stormwater drainage done by your own team, is the kind of work I want to learn. I have not yet worked on an Australian construction site, so I would expect to learn your systems under supervision. I live in Melton, close to Derrimut, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.
Thank you for reading this. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and I would be glad to talk whenever a graduate role opens. My portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
